en.headline: Debby Shing and students show cloisonne works at PMQ until month end
en.dek: Free exhibition at LIVIN ARTSPACE in Central runs daily noon to 7pm through 30 November, featuring pieces by the artist and more than 20 students.
body: Hong Kong cloisonne artist Debby Shing and more than 20 of her students are presenting their works in the exhibition Cloisonne, Reimagined at LIVIN ARTSPACE in PMQ, Central.

The free show runs daily from noon to 7pm until 30 November at unit H303 in the Hollywood block. Shing founded LIVIN ARTSPACE in 2020 as the city's first cloisonne thangka atelier after apprenticing with Tibetan master Tsultrim Norbu.

The works draw on Tibetan iconography alongside Chinese opera portraiture and contemporary approaches, using fine gold wires filled with enamel. Organisers said the exhibition highlights both traditional technique and how the craft is being reimagined in Hong Kong.
Admission is free and no booking is required. The atelier also offers workshops and continues other displays at the same address.

zh.headline: 成影翠師生掐絲琺瑯展元創方展出至月底
zh.dek: 中環LIVIN ARTSPACE免費展覽每日中午至晚上7時開放，至11月30日止，展出藝術家及逾20名學生作品。
body: 香港掐絲琺瑯藝術家成影翠連同逾20名學生，在中環元創方LIVIN ARTSPACE舉辦《相映成翠》師生展。
展覽每日中午12時至晚上7時開放，至11月30日結束，場地位於荷李活座H303。成影翠於2020年創立全港首間掐絲琺瑯唐卡藝術空間，此前曾拜青海玉樹唐卡大師次成諾布為師。
作品以藏族圖像為靈感，亦包括中國戲曲人物及當代詮釋，以金絲勾勒後填入琺瑯。主辦方表示，展覽呈現傳統工藝與香港重新想像這門藝術的可能。
入場免費，毋須預約。該空間同期亦有工作坊及其他展出。
